reason: The case essentially requires non-wildcard tuple destructuring assignments, including named targets, rest targets and nested record/list targets. Rest assignment patterns such as [a, ...b] = x and [...a] = x
Nested mapping/list assignment patterns such as [a, { field1: b, field2: c }] and [[e5, e6]]
